title: Make kbs setup agents explain and report what it rewrites
description: Without --force: 'Error: Kanbus section already exists in AGENTS.md. Re-run with --force to overwrite.' exit 1, and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md is not regenerated. --help says only 'Ensure AGENTS.md contains Kanbus instructions'. --force rewrites hand-tuned AGENTS.md Kanbus-section wording and creates project/AGENTS.md, DO_NOT_EDIT files and event files without listing them. Wanted: help text that states exactly what each mode writes; a mode that regenerates CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md only (no AGENTS.md change), so methodology changes do not require --force; print every file created or rewritten.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Biblicus on 0.36.0 adds: kbs setup agents --force rewrites the hand-edited AGENTS.md Kanbus section on every run (project wording such as 'sins' is reverted each regeneration). Include a supported way to keep project wording for that section, e.g. a project override template for the AGENTS.md Kanbus section, alongside the CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md-only regenerate mode.
